description: Regression test for TKA-10822 - Mend for GHE SCA: the pip resolver marks a scan partial because of a urllib3 version installed by the scan's OWN pipdeptree step. requirements.txt pins boto3~=1.26.64 -> botocore<1.30 -> urllib3<1.27, so `pip install -r requirements.txt` resolves urllib3 1.26.x. With python.resolveHierarchyTree=true the scanner then runs `pip install pipdeptree`; pipdeptree's transitive dep nab-index>=0.0.11 requires urllib3>=2.0 and upgrades the venv to urllib3 2.7.0. The skip-filter suppresses urllib3-2.7.0 for the repo-root resolution path but NOT for the requirements.txt path, emitting a RESOLUTION WARN 'Failed to resolve the following dependencies: [urllib3-2.7.0]' and marking the scan partial - even though urllib3-2.7.0 was never requested by the project. The discriminating signal is a scanner-log fingerprint (see logs.expected_log_lines): the test FAILS while the bug is present (WARN lines present) and PASSES once the skip-filter propagates to every per-manifest path (WARN lines absent). Wired with pytest.mark.xfail in tests/python/pip/test_scan_python_pip_projects.py.

scan_output._comment_total_libs_scanned: requirements.txt (boto3, beautifulsoup4, requests) + setup.py (six) resolve to well over 5 libs once botocore/certifi/idna/urllib3/etc. are pulled. Lenient lower bound because transitive counts vary with pip resolver versions. urllib3-2.7.0 is NOT a real project dep and must not inflate the count.

dependency_tree._comment_check_update_request_sca_result: Kept true per project convention. NOTE: it is NOT the discriminator for TKA-10822 - the bug produces a level=WARN entry with success:false while totalFail stays {} (ticket: totalSuccess {HOOKS:23, RESOLUTION:1}, totalFail {}). check_update_request_sca_results only fails on totalFail!={} or a level=ERROR entry, so it passes in both states. The log fingerprint below is the real discriminator.
dependency_tree._comment_expected_direct_dependencies_nu: Lenient gte per project convention for counts. boto3, beautifulsoup4, requests are the requirements.txt direct deps (>=3). six comes from setup.py. Not eq because hierarchy grouping of the two manifests varies.
dependency_tree._comment_direct_dependencies_names_list: Lenient contains of two stable direct deps. Mend emits pip artifactIds in wheel-filename form (e.g. boto3-1.26.165-py3-none-any.whl); the framework PEP 503 canonicalization (feedback_pep503_normalisation_framework_level) folds them to boto3 / requests, so the short names match. Intentionally NOT asserting on urllib3: urllib3-1.26.20 is a legitimate transitive in BOTH states and urllib3-2.7.0 is never fetched for the project in either state, so an inventory check does not distinguish bug-from-fixed - only the log fingerprint does.

expected_log_lines._comment: Positive check: confirms the trigger config is active (proven format - the sibling ignore-pip-install probe asserts python.ignorePipInstallErrors=true the same way). If absent, the pipdeptree contamination path never ran and the repro is not exercising the right scenario.

expected_log_lines.value: Failed to resolve the following dependencies: [urllib3-2.7.0]
expected_log_lines._comment: PRIMARY DISCRIMINATOR. Negative check (passes when ABSENT). BUG PRESENT: the skip-filter misses the requirements.txt path -> this RESOLUTION WARN is emitted for urllib3-2.7.0 (a pipdeptree/nab-index-introduced version) -> substring present -> 'ne' FAILS -> reproduction confirmed (test xfails). BUG FIXED: skip-filter propagates to every per-manifest path -> no WARN -> substring absent -> 'ne' PASSES -> test xpasses.

expected_log_lines.value: might not have been resolved completely
expected_log_lines._comment: SECONDARY DISCRIMINATOR. Negative check. The ticket shows the requirements.txt path logs 'dependency: urllib3-2.7.0 from .../requirements.txt, might not have been resolved completely' three times instead of the correct skip line. This phrase does not appear for this clean project once the bug is fixed. BUG PRESENT -> present -> FAILS; BUG FIXED -> absent -> PASSES.
